Explosion Heard in Riyadh as Saudi Arabia Intercepts Missiles

A powerful explosion was heard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, accompanied by smoke seen near the airport. Saudi Arabia intercepted missiles, which caused the explosion. The exact location of the explosion was not immediately clear.
